question: Should memory-lancedb add hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval, and should that behavior be default-preserving opt-in or enabled by default?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding plugin config, index creation, scoring, and fallback behavior changes retrieval semantics for persisted memory and needs maintainer product/compatibility intent first.

options.title: Approve opt-in hybrid retrieval
options.body: Add a plugin-owned hybrid mode with explicit config, FTS setup/repair, query-text propagation, and vector-only fallback while leaving current vector behavior as the default until proven safe.

options.title: Approve default-on hybrid retrieval
options.body: Make hybrid retrieval the normal memory-lancedb behavior, but require upgrade proof that recall ordering, duplicate detection, and failures do not surprise existing users.

options.title: Defer LanceDB parity
options.body: Keep memory-lancedb vector-only for now and direct users needing richer retrieval to memory-core or a separately maintained plugin until the memory product direction changes.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in hybrid retrieval
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned hybrid mode with explicit config, FTS setup/repair, query-text propagation, and vector-only fallback while leaving current vector behavior as the default until proven safe.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current memory-lancedb history and already posted a prior maintainer-side review on this issue.
